name: manual_ed3b14
claim: Judge a LAN send only by the drop's own JSON: ok true, a received_at, and a byte count equal to the file size. A queued record is not delivery, and a count of queued sidecars counts files, not peers: one broadcast file for one assignee was reported as queued to three peers. Read the per-item sidecar before stating how many peers a send reached.

decisions.notes: An agent report claimed three peers from an outbox count of three queued files; the sidecar showed one file, one assignee.

rationale: An agent report claimed three peers from an outbox count of three queued files; the sidecar showed one file, one assignee.
